redCandidate.publicEntry: advanceLongRunningDelivery() from the rex-harness package entry point
redCandidate.setup: Start a verified two-feature delivery where dependent is declared before prerequisite and depends on prerequisite, then submit a matching zero-exit receipt for prerequisite.
redCandidate.expected: The decision continues with dependent as the sole current feature after prerequisite is accepted.
redCandidate.observed: The recorded focused suite exits 1 because the current index-based transition completes after prerequisite instead of selecting earlier dependent.
redCandidate.failureReason: advanceLongRunningDelivery selects only pending features after the current array index and ignores dependency acceptance state.
